description: This source file defines the EmployeeReport class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the HRM Time plugin. It implements functionalities for preparing report filter parameters, validation rules, report access control, header setup, and data retrieval for employee time reports. The class uses traits for user role management and internationalization, and interacts with various project and employee report data models.

classes.name: EmployeeReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating employee time reports, including request parameter processing, validation, access control, header definition, filtering, and data provisioning within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters for the employee report based on request inputs.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines and returns validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Ensures the user has permission to access the employee report, throws exception if not authorized.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns report header configuration including columns and localization.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report, in this case, an empty filter.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and returns the report data based on provided filter parameters.
